title: Adani Power, Druk ink pact to set up 770 MW hydropower project in Bhutan
description:
Adani Power on Tuesday said it has inked a pact with Bhutan's state utility Druk Green Power Corp Ltd for setting up the 770 MW Chamkharchhu-I Hydroelectric Project in the Kingdom of Bhutan.
Adani Power and DGPC, Bhutan's state-owned generation utility, signed a Shareholders Agreement (SHA) for setting up the project, according to a statement.
The project marks the second major hydropower collaboration between the two partners, following the 570 MW Wangchhu Hydroelectric Project agreement signed in September 2025. It is also part of the broader 5,000 MW hydropower development Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between the Adani Group and DGPC in May 2025.
The signing ceremony was attended by Bhutan Prime Minister Lyonchhen Dasho Tshering Tobgay and other dignitaries.
